title: ieee80211: show last received frame in block ack response
description:
In a Block Ack Response, the useful information to be extracted from the bitmap
are the last received and correct frame and the not received or incorrect
frames before that last frame. The missing frames after are usually frames yet
to be send not missed frames.

I'm not sure about the quality of the code here nor the choice of `Last found` for the last frame. And there is a similar code to handle multi sta block sta, it could be a good idea to make the change there too.

I like the idea. I might say something like "Last acknowledged frame." There are some sample captures in #20156.

You could, I suppose, traverse the bitmap in reverse order to find the last set bit, save the position (possibly adding the item and then moving just it at the end), and then break out of the loop and traverse it in order until that position. That would get rid of the large number of moves but might be complicated in its own way. (Note that the functions in `wsutil/ws_ctz.h` can be used to determine the last bit set in a 64-bit integer, though you have to handle the 0 case specially.)

commits_data.title: ieee80211: refactor all the block ack bitmap dissect code
commits_data.message:
ieee80211: refactor all the block ack bitmap dissect code

Compressed block ack, extended compressed block ack and multi-STA block
ack had similar code to dissect their BA bitmap. Merge and refactor in
one function of all the code.

Futhermore, in a Block Ack Response, the useful information to be extracted
from the bitmap are the last ack frame and the nack frames before that
last frame. The nack frames after are usually frames yet to be send not
missed or incorrect frames. Display the last ack frame and do not
display the nack frames following it.
